SELECT 
    p.onimennyye,
    p.regiin,
    b.onimennyye AS broker_name,
    b.inn,
    SUM(v.volume_units) AS total_volume
FROM 
    participants p
JOIN 
    brokers b ON p.inn = b.inn
JOIN 
    deal_enriched d ON p.inn = d.seller_inn
JOIN 
    deal_enriched v ON d.deal_id = v.deal_id

GROUP BY 
    p.onimennyye, p.regiin, b.onimennyye, b.inn
ORDER BY 
    total_volume DESC
